errors.daemon_timeout: the daemon at {url} did not answer in time

cli.purge_warning:
!! -purge-data deletes the Thulu database, every project worktree, the
!! TLS certificates, deploy/.env (the database password and the credential
!! key) and every snapshot in {backups}.
!! There is no undo: export what you need first (thulu export).
cli.helm_uninstall_intro:
This install runs on Kubernetes. Nothing is removed from here; run these
yourself against the cluster (the last two delete the data plane's namespaces
and everything in them):
cli.helm_delete_values: Then delete {path}: it holds the install's secrets in clear text.
cli.helm_external_database: The database is external to the chart; drop it with your own tooling.
cli.binary_stays: This binary stays; remove it yourself: rm {path}

runner_service.not_running: Installed but not running; look at {log}.
runner_service.uninstalled: Runner service removed, with its log.
runner_service.status_none: The runner service is not installed (`thulu runner service install`).
runner_service.status_running: The runner runs as a service ({file}).
runner_service.status_stopped: The runner service is installed but stopped ({file}).
runner_service.status_exited: The runner service is installed but not running: its last run exited with {code} ({file}).
runner_service.status_orphan: The runner service is still loaded but its file {file} is gone; `thulu runner service uninstall` stops it.
runner_service.kept_env: Kept from the previous service file: {names} ({file}). Set or change a variable with service_env in runner.json.

runner_doctor.mode_legacy: Local tools: {mode} (runner.json has local_mcp_config and no local_tools)
runner_doctor.mode_default: Local tools: {mode} (default; change it with `thulu runner config local-tools`)
runner_doctor.mode_means_thulu: Runs get only the MCPs Thulu wires in (--strict-mcp-config).
runner_doctor.mode_means_selected: Runs get Thulu's MCPs plus the ones selected below.
runner_doctor.mode_means_all: Runs get every MCP this machine has, claude.ai connectors included.
runner_doctor.env_override: {name} is set: the MCP file is {path}, whatever runner.json says.
runner_doctor.mcp_thulu: The task's own MCPs (octopus-api and the agent's): always loaded.
runner_doctor.list_failed: Could not ask claude for this machine's MCPs: {err}
runner_doctor.no_mcps: This machine has no MCP of its own.
runner_doctor.state_policy: denied by a Claude Code policy
runner_doctor.state_off: selected, but disabled or pending approval in claude
runner_doctor.state_unchecked: selected; claude could not be asked whether it connects
runner_doctor.state_missing: selected, but the MCP file does not define it
runner_doctor.state_not_connected: selected, but this claude.ai account has no such connector
runner_doctor.bypass_on: Bypass mode allowed: runs skip permission prompts.
runner_doctor.bypass_off: Bypass mode turned off by {source}: runs go in dontAsk mode and may use only what is allowed.
runner_doctor.allowed_none: allowed_tools is empty: runs get only their MCP tools, no Bash, Edit or Write. Set it with `thulu runner config allowed-tools`.
runner_doctor.allowed_unused: allowed_tools ({tools}) only counts while a policy turns bypass mode off.
runner_doctor.server_managed: Settings an admin sets in claude.ai reach claude over the network and are not shown here.
runner_doctor.service_unreadable: Could not read the service file: {err}
runner_doctor.claude_missing: claude is not on that PATH: runs from the service will not find it. Add its directory to service_env.PATH in runner.json and run `thulu runner service install`.
runner_doctor.memory_run: Each run is capped at {limit}, the agent and everything it starts (run_memory_limit_mb).
runner_doctor.memory_min_free: No new runs while the machine has less than {min} available (min_free_memory_mb).
runner_doctor.memory_floor: The largest run stops when the machine has less than {floor} available (machine_memory_floor_mb).
runner_doctor.disk_work_dir: The work dir {path} holds {size}: run folders, task worktrees and the runner's clone of each project.
runner_doctor.disk_build_cache: A task worktree's build cache over {max} goes when a run ends (build_cache_max_mb).
runner_doctor.disk_build_cache_off: Build caches stay whatever their size (build_cache_max_mb is negative).
